## Context / Problem
An immutable census of all 249 prose blocks (124 true leading docstrings, 125 maximal full-line comment regions) in these eighteen unit-test modules found 32 editable blocks (31 docstrings, 1 comment region; 3,069 before-words), frozen at `origin/main@d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84`. Revalidation maps the moved autodeploy spans to the sequenced-df comment and measurement oracle and rejects their now-executable numeric ranges.

## Approach
Edit only the frozen prose blocks below. A `D:<owner>` is the leading `Expr(Constant(str))` in a `Module`, `ClassDef`, `FunctionDef`, or `AsyncFunctionDef`. A `C:<scope>:before:<anchor>` is one maximal consecutive full-line COMMENT-token region, owned by the innermost AST scope and anchored to a following unchanged non-comment code. Compact `D{a,b}` and `C{scope@anchor,...}` notation expands to those exact IDs under the row's path; the reviewer writes the fully path-qualified `<path>#<ID>`.

For every owned path, retain immutable before and final blobs and parse both with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`. On comparison copies remove only allowlisted leading docstring nodes; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; require the remaining `ast.dump(..., include_attributes=False)` values to match. Tokenize both blobs and reject changed inline comments or non-allowlisted full-line comments. Preserve runtime strings, regexes, prompts, imports, decorators, annotations, assertions, subprocess arguments, test data, shebangs, and complete directive-bearing physical lines exactly. Only adjacent blank-line normalization around an edited block is allowed.

## Protected false positives
All 217 unlisted blocks are protected, notably attestation gate-ref setup/negative-control comments; concise audit/helper docstrings; autodeploy's cap-source, timeout, extraction, minimal-env and cap-script rationale; and bare-exempt helper prose. Preserve the literal DSSE PAE formula semantically, embedded shell/shebang text byte-exact, and every `noqa`/`type: ignore` directive line exactly.

## Preserved contracts and consumers
Keep portable API baseline scope/drift shapes; DSSE PAE and adversarial round trips; op-cert subject/trust/storage-era and SSHSIG fail-closed matrices; overlay grandfathering plus attested/local gate-ref anchors; separate code/ticket roots; full coaching and v2 audit buckets/evidence/thresholds; audit-server lazy/default-off/bind behavior; ticket-page DOM and legacy `kind`; batched authorship equivalence and rendered Git/object-store forensics; capped fail-soft autodeploy with sequenced `df` measurements; and exempt-minus-bug-tier membership. `test_authorship_fixture_maintenance.py` reads the authorship module, `test_payload_shadow_effect_spies.py` reads the held-out audit-server source, and `test_tests_import_convention.py` pairs the audit-page modules. API docs and `gen_api_surface.py` cite the API gate. No `__doc__`, `inspect.getdoc`, or pydoc consumer reads an allowlisted value.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only the declared stable-ID blocks and adjacent blank lines change; the AST and token/comment comparisons pass on every owned path.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter and retains the listed current contract while removing chronology, duplication, obvious narration, or separator ornament.
- [ ] [non-codebase] A non-author reviewer posts exactly 32 leaf-linked TSV rows: `stable_block_id<TAB>before_citation<TAB>final_citation<TAB>preserved_contract_or_consumer<TAB>directives_exact<TAB>before_words<TAB>after_words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer_session`.
- [ ] [non-codebase] Before citations use `d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84:<path>#<stable-id>`; final citations use `<final-commit-sha>:<path>#<stable-id>`; every row has `after_words < before_words` and records `directives_exact=PASS`, `semantic-preservation=PASS`, and `bloat-removal=PASS`.
- [ ] [non-codebase] The first four structured verify commands pass; Gerrit `Verified +1` is the accepted substitute for the fifth `full-verify` command under this epic's comments-only CI waiver.

## Verification
The five DD-level commands recorded on this ticket run focused pytest with real consumers, scoped Ruff check plus format-check, comment hygiene, owned-path diff integrity, and untimed worktree-venv `make verify`. They are the executable completion oracle.
